description: Phase series three-phase power meter with expansion modules: system settings, voltages, currents, powers, power factor, frequency, unbalance, harmonics and alarm status
source: Manual de Utilização Série Phase, Rev. E 09/2015

sources.title: Manual de Utilização Série Phase (MU215100)
sources.note: linked in issue #115; chapter 5 (MODBUS RTU Escravo), tables 5-7 to 5-15

notes: Modbus RTU on the RS-485 channel of the PH3100 (terminals 15 TX+, 16 TX-, 17 shield), 1 start, 8 data and 1 stop bit. The manual does not state a default baud rate or parity: 9600 N is a placeholder. Baud rates 2400 to 38400 (register 0x0103); address 1 to 247 (register 0x0100), factory address 1. Only function codes 03, 06 and 16 are described, so every register is a holding register.

The PH3150/PH3250 Ethernet module serves Modbus TCP/IP, or Modbus RTU over TCP/IP, with one connection. TCP/IP is the factory protocol from PH3100 revision AJ; RTU over TCP needs the PH3101 configurator 2.19 or later. The module's factory IP is given in the manual; the port is not stated here, 502 is assumed.
Addresses are those printed in the manual (hexadecimal), taken as wire addresses (0-based). The manual warns that masters that start at 1 need address + 1.

Registers 0x0300 to 0x0320 do not state a unit or decimals. The manual only says to multiply voltages by the VT ratio (register 0x0101) and currents by the CT ratio (register 0x0102). They are given as raw values: check against the display before applying a scale.

Not included: the energy registers (0x1A00 onward), which split a value into a quotient and a remainder in a way the manual does not make clear, the demand, maximum and minimum tables, the monthly profile registers (addresses in that part of the table are inconsistent) and the harmonic spectrum tables. The harmonics module (PH3131) is required for the harmonic registers.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
